body.statement: Theorem 3. For any minimizer \(w^*\), the assignment and sign-pattern enumeration in \(\mathrm{def:exact\text{-}calibration}\) terminates after finitely many semialgebraic feasibility decisions, computes \(c_{\alpha,r}(w^*)\) and \(\gamma_{\alpha,r}(w^*)\), and gives \(\phi_{\alpha,r,w^*}\) worst-null rejection probability at most \(\alpha\) for every \(r\). Also \(c_{\alpha,r}(w^*)\le\sqrt{V^{\mathrm{quad}}_r/\alpha}\), and its worst-alternative power is at least \(1-\eta\) whenever \[\delta_{\mathrm{sq}}\ge\sqrt{V^{\mathrm{quad}}_r/\alpha}+\sqrt{V^{\mathrm{quad}}_r/\eta}.\]
body.justification: With the Bernoulli-half reproduction identity imported from GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026 Section 4 and Appendix B, finite-sample calibration closes the nonsharp-null gap without losing the fourth-root scale.
body.gap: GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026, arXiv version 2, Proposition 4.1 supplies an MSE envelope using Lemmas S3--S4; it does not compute an exact worst-null critical value over bounded schedules. TiwariBasu2026 proves asymptotic validity for a different statistic.
